findings.title: Native tool execution is a forgeable self-consistent grammar loop
findings.evidence: Plaintext fake executables/DBs, metadata-only scripts and handwritten logs/reports pass the complete extractor; VCS argv has neither -R nor simv nor source paths; independently forged marker-only VCS/Formality logs parse as PASS/SUCCEEDED.
findings.impact: A future authority could admit bytes that no Synopsys tool executed.
findings.required_repair: Wrapper-owned execve/process receipts; valid tool scripts; distinct VCS compile and simv run; runtime-derived executable/version/argv/log/exit roots.

findings.title: Full ten-operator scope is self-asserted rather than derived
findings.evidence: An empty design RTL and empty mapped-netlist top pass complete extraction; design_name and operator_scope_sha256 are only string/digest equality checks.
findings.impact: Selected-slice or empty-top PPA can masquerade as full M527 after a future authority is added.
findings.required_repair: Frozen source/top plus elaboration, hierarchy/reference, operator-instance, VCS census and Formality compare-point roots from which scope is derived.

findings.title: SAIF and PTPX activity annotation are not semantically closed
findings.evidence: A header-only SAIF passes the complete chain; no duration, instance root, toggle population, read_saif or annotation coverage is required.
findings.impact: Reported dynamic power need not correspond to the VCS workload.
findings.required_repair: Require nonzero SAIF duration/population, exact top/root and PTPX read_saif plus annotation-coverage evidence.

findings.title: Macro physical integration and area semantics are not reconciled
findings.evidence: Empty netlist plus a handwritten nonzero memory group passes; macro names/counts are not checked in netlist/hierarchy; DC Total cell area is labelled logic and macro datasheet area is added without proving whether DC already included macros.
findings.impact: Zero/unintegrated SRAM can masquerade as integrated and Table-A area can double count macros.
findings.required_repair: Exact 8+8+1 macro instance/reference census across netlist/DC/PT/PTPX and an explicit hierarchical macro-area inclusion or subtraction proof.

findings.title: Direct extractor permits a tiny negative post-subtraction logic component
findings.evidence: Independent fixture yields logic_internal_power_mw=-5.000166947155549e-13 under the extractor's -1e-12 tolerance; the downstream registry number gate does reject it.
findings.impact: No current admission impact, but the direct extractor violates strict negative rejection.
findings.required_repair: Reject every negative derived component or perform explicit report-resolution reconciliation before emitting a nonnegative value.
